versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md to clean up unused documentation.
- No changes were made to the skill functionality or user-facing documentation.

- Added a Postmark logo image to the documentation for improved visual clarity.
- Minor edits to the documentation (SKILL.md) for presentation and branding consistency.
- Removed the skill-card.md file to streamline documentation.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release.

- Inspect transactional email activity, templates, messages, and delivery workflows in Postmark via ClawLink.

- Safeguards to confirm actions before write operations, with emphasis on read-first workflows.
- Dynamic discovery and usage of available Postmark tools through ClawLink integration.
- Clear rules to ensure security and prevent credential sharing in chat.
